status: Stage 3 seed. Representative cases only; Stage 7 extends to about 40 legitimate and at least 10 attack cases per scenario 1-4, appending new IDs after the last one used here. IDs are never renumbered or reused. 0.2.0 (Stage 6, TP23): added Milestone 2 cases EVAL-093 to EVAL-105; EVAL-054 and EVAL-068 activated by TP5 and TP7. 0.3.0 (Stage 7, TKT-08): added scenario 1 attack cases EVAL-110 to EVAL-113 (scenario 1 to 11 active S1 cases). 0.4.0 (Stage 7, TKT-07): added plot-laundering fixtures X08 to X10 and scenario 3 attack cases EVAL-106 to EVAL-108 (scenario 3 to 10 active S1 cases).

conventions.evidence_matching: Scorer lowercases both the evidence sentence and each expected substring and strips all whitespace before a substring test, so '182 m' matches '182m' and '182 M'.
conventions.evidence_format: Distances in whole metres, speeds in whole km/h, loss percentages to one decimal with a % sign, yield as a multiple of the reference upper bound to two decimals followed by 'x' (see evaluation-plan.md §7.4).
conventions.yield_units: Yield is expressed as a ratio of U, the upper bound (max kg/ha) of the fixture crop reference row, after the cherry-to-clean conversion. No real Coffee Board figures appear in this file.
conventions.gps_distance: gps_place.distance_m is measured from the nearest polygon edge; 'inside_*' places are inside the polygon, 'outside_*' outside it.
conventions.independence: Every case is evaluated with its own context; no state carries between cases, so results do not depend on execution order.

yield_reference.note: U is a placeholder symbol. Stage 6 seeds crop_yield_reference from Coffee Board of India figures once verified (risk R6); until then the harness uses a synthetic U and every case is written as a multiple of it, so the cases stay valid when the real figure replaces it.
